Guides

Wallpaper sources

Keep images on your machine or pull them from a GitHub repository. Choose an exact image or a reproducible random selection.

Local directories#

config.toml
[sources.wallpapers]
kind = "local-directory"
path = "~/Pictures/wallpapers"

Paths may be absolute, begin with ~/, or be relative to config.toml. Other shell expansions are not supported. PNG and JPEG images are supported.

GitHub repositories#

config.toml
[sources.wallpapers]
kind = "github"
repository = "owner/repo"
ref = "main"
path = "wallpapers"

Replace owner/repo with your repository. Both ref and path are optional: omitting them uses the default branch and repository root.

Each plan resolves the requested branch to a commit. For authentication or higher rate limits, set GITHUB_TOKEN in your environment; never put a token in a profile or source file.

Select an image#

Profile · exact image
[wallpaper]
mode = "source"
source = "wallpapers"
selection = "path"
path = "city/night.png"

The image path is relative to the source. For random selection, use selection = "random" and omit path.

Terminal
ghostty-wall plan night --seed 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
ghostty-wall apply night --seed 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f

Random selection requires a 32-byte seed, written as 64 hex digits. The same seed and unchanged source produce the same selection.

Random selection

Version 1 does not include automatic timed wallpaper rotation.

Control the image#

SettingSupported values
fitcontain, cover, stretch, none
positionFor example, center, top-left, bottom-right
opacity0 to 1; lower values make text easier to read
repeattrue or false

Omit the wallpaper section to leave it unmanaged. Use mode = "none" to explicitly disable the background image.
